samples.summary: New keyboard-exit tests never assert the bullet is actually gone (listKind/listLevel cleared) on the restored heading
samples.evidence: `keyboard list exits restore the heading` (test/view/list-heading-roundtrip.test.ts:149-172) only asserts `block.type === 'heading'` and `block.headingLevel`. Nothing asserts `block.listKind`/`block.listLevel` are undefined, which is what stops paint-layout.ts:192 from drawing a marker and what `MemDocStore.setBlockType` (src/store/memory.ts:251-253) does. A regression that restored the heading level while leaving list attrs behind (e.g. a future store change that preserves listKind the way it now preserves headingLevel) would leave both new tests green. Contrast the sibling store tests at lines 109-118, which do assert the negative side (`headingLevel` undefined).
